answer: Proof of Burn mechanisms effectively inhibit Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Much like a bee expending energy to wander between flowers for nectar, an agent must sacrifice capital to prove its commitment to the ecosystem. By treating the network as an orchard of verifiable identities, we ensure that an attacker pays a prohibitive cost in scorched assets for every fraudulent identity they attempt to cultivate.
